Pure C# PP-OCRv5 and PP-OCRv6 inference (DET + CLS + REC). Cross-platform hand-written kernels and GEMM; optional GPU backends over Vulkan and Metal (macOS), .NET 10 only. Very high performance, low memory requirements, and very high accuracy. No Paddle Inference, ONNX Runtime, or OpenCV native lib…
